title: Identically Trained Language Models Break on Different Jailbreaks
abstract: arXiv:2610.34074v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Jailbreak benchmarks test one checkpoint and treat which jailbreaks break it as a property of its pretraining data and safety training. We ask whether another pretraining run of the same data, given the same safety training, would break on the same jailbreaks. For each of 25 pretraining data recipes, we take 1B base models from 3 pretraining seeds and give each the same safety post-training with 2 post-training seeds, for 150 models in all. We then collect 20 responses from every model to a shared set of jailbreak prompts and correlate the per-prompt non-refusal rates between every pair of models. On average, two post-trained copies of the same pretraining run have per-prompt non-refusal rates that correlate at 0.984. A different pretraining seed lowers the correlation to 0.811, and a different data recipe lowers it only slightly further, to 0.779. translated_title: 相同方式训练的语言模型会被不同的越狱攻击所攻破
translated_abstract: 越狱基准测试通常只测试单个模型检查点，并将哪些越狱攻击能攻破它视为其预训练数据和安全性训练的固有属性。我们提出疑问：如果使用相同的预训练数据进行另一次预训练，并给予相同的安全性训练，模型是否会在相同的越狱攻击下被攻破？针对25种预训练数据配方，我们分别从3个预训练随机种子中获取1B规模的基础模型，并对每个模型施加由2个后训练随机种子产生的相同安全后训练，共计150个模型。随后，我们收集每个模型对一组共享越狱提示的20个回复，并计算每对模型之间逐提示非拒绝率的相关性。结果显示，同一预训练运行的两个安全后训练副本的逐提示非拒绝率相关性平均高达0.984；更换不同的预训练种子会使相关性降至0.811，而更换不同的数据配方仅使其进一步小幅下降至0.779。这些结果表明，哪些越狱攻击能攻破一个模型检查点，更多取决于其（预训练运行的随机性，摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该研究通过训练150个模型发现，即使数据配方和安全训练完全相同，不同预训练随机种子产生的模型对不同越狱攻击的脆弱性差异显著，表明模型的越狱易感模式主要由预训练运行的随机性决定，而非数据或安全训练。
en_tdlr: Identically trained language models with different pretraining seeds break on different jailbreaks, showing that a model's vulnerability pattern to jailbreak attacks is driven by pretraining randomness rather than the data recipe or safety training itself.
